ticket.title: auth-service nodes report errors writing files and then crash
ticket.description: Several instances became unhealthy within an hour. Disk alerts fired on the hosts.

runbooks.title: Disk space alerts and write failures
runbooks.content: Possible causes: runaway log volume, large temp files, a stuck log rotation, data growth. Check which directory grew, the log level, and whether rotation is working.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: Release 8.4.0 switched the log level from INFO to DEBUG, log files filled the disk and writes began to fail
